content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Mesa

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and verifiable project-management experience. Review PMI's specific requirements for your background—whether you hold a bachelor's degree, associate degree, or high school diploma shapes your experience threshold. Gather documentation of your project work before you apply.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Certification Training course. Our experienced, active certified practitioners deliver interactive sessions on PMI's five process groups and ten knowledge areas. Attend all sessions, participate in case studies, and earn your formal 35 contact hours—a prerequisite for PMI application.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After course completion, create your PMI profile and submit your official PMP application, including your verified education and project-management experience. Pay PMI's examination fee. PMI will review your submission; most applicants receive approval within two weeks. Respond promptly to any audit requests.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and review sessions—to reinforce course content. Schedule your computer-based exam with Pearson VUE at a test center convenient to you. Prepare thoroughly, then sit for the four-hour, 200-question assessment.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Upon passing, you earn your PMP credential with a three-year renewal cycle. Maintain it by earning professional development units (PDUs) through authorized training, conference attendance, volunteer work, or self-directed learning. Plan ahead so you meet PMI's renewal requirements before your credential expires.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
